newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB: LOS ANGELES COMPLETE EDITION AVAILABLE FOR PLAYSTATION 3 AND XBOX 360
newsItem.body:
Midnight Club: Los Angeles enters the Greatest Hits library for PLAYSTATION®3 and the Platinum Hits collection for Xbox 360® in true Rockstar fashion - with a full upgrade including all of the South Central cars, races, neighborhoods, music and more that were previously only available as downloadable content.

---Midnight Club: Los Angeles Compete Edition has everything that came included in the original jam-packed release of Midnight Club: Los Angeles, and also includes:

The South Central Map Expansion - Adding an entire extra 1/3 of Los Angeles territory to the already massive in-game map. Four distinct neighborhoods: Baldwin, Crenshaw, Exposition and Huntington - filled with such iconic landmarks as the USC campus, Shrine Auditorium, and Crenshaw Plaza.

The South Central Premium Upgrade - 9 new licensed vehicles including classic lowriders like the '64 Impala and mean luxury SUVs like the Range Rover Supercharged, plus a ton of new races, battle maps, delivery missions, red light races, vinyl packs, new aftermarket parts and new music.

South Central Vehicle Packs 1 & 2 - Hit the streets with 7 additional licensed vehicles: The Aston Martin DB9, Audi S5, Cadillac XLR V, Ducati 1098 R, Mercedes CL 65, Mitsubishi Eclipse GT and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution X.

All this plus the complete collection of cars, missions, multiplayer modes, music and more from the original release of Midnight Club: Los Angeles, available for just $29.99 - purchase right now from Rockstar Warehouse and other retailers worldwide.

newsItem.headline: SOUTH CENTRAL VEHICLE PACK #2 NOW AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD
newsItem.body:
The second South Central Vehicle Pack for Midnight Club: Los Angeles is now available on Xbox LIVE and PSN for 240 MS points/$2.99. South Central Vehicle Pack 2 brings power and status, featuring the 2008 Cadillac XLR V, the 2008 Lancer Evolution X, the 2007 Aston Martin DB9 and the bonus 2008 Ducati 1098 R. In celebration of its release, we’ve added another all-new gameplay clip featuring the cars and bikes of vehicle pack 2.

---To access the new vehicles, players will need to download the free South Central Map Expansion that increases the total map size by one-third and adds four neighborhoods to make up the iconic district of South Central.

newsItem.headline: SOUTH CENTRAL VEHICLE PACK #1 NOW AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD
newsItem.body:
The first South Central Vehicle Pack for Midnight Club: Los Angeles is now available on Xbox LIVE® and PlayStation®Network for 240 MS points/$2.99. The pack includes three brand new high-performance vehicles for players to cruise the streets of Los Angeles in, including the luxurious 2008 Audi S5 and 2008 Mercedes-Benz CL 65 AMG, along with the 2009 Mitsubishi Eclipse GT.

---To commemorate this first vehicle pack we've released an all-new gameplay clip showcasing the new vehicles in their splendor.

To access the new vehicles players will need to download the free South Central Map Expansion that increases the total map size by one-third and adds four neighborhoods to make up the iconic district of South Central. Stay tuned for Vehicle Pack 2 hitting Xbox LIVE and PSN next Thursday, April 23.

newsItem.headline: SOUTH CENTRAL VEHICLE PACKS ANNOUNCED
newsItem.body:
Seven new vehicles will be hitting the streets of Midnight Club: Los Angeles over the next few weeks, with the release of two South Central Vehicle Packs. Each pack will be available on Xbox LIVE® for 240 points and on the PlayStation®Network for $2.99.

---South Central Vehicle Pack 1 will be available on April 16th and will feature two luxury class cars, an Audi S5 and the Mercedes CL 65, along with the 2009 Mitsubishi Eclipse GT.

South Central Vehicle Pack 2 will be released on April 23rd and will feature 3 cars along with a bonus motorcycle for free. Cruise South Central in a Cadillac XLR V, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution X and an Aston Martin DB9. We've also included the Ducati 1098 R motorcycle as an added bonus.

To access the content in each pack you will also need to download the free South Central Map Expansion which expands the massive city of Midnight Club: Los Angeles by one third, adding four new neighborhoods to make up the iconic district of South Central.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB: LOS ANGELES – SOUTH CENTRAL NOW AVAILABLE
newsItem.body:

newsItem.headline: XBOX LIVE GAME WITH FAME EVENT LIVE FROM THE DUB SHOW IN LA ON 3.22.09: PLAY WITH DJ FELLI FEL AND OTHER WEST COAST ALL – STARS
newsItem.body:
March 22, 2009 1pm to 5pm PST on Xbox LIVE

To celebrate the launch of Midnight Club Los Angeles: South Central downloadable dontent, Rockstar Games and Xbox are giving you the chance to play Midnight Club: Los Angeles against an all-star line-up of West Coast hip-hop legends and up-and-coming artists, as they play live from the kickoff of the 2009 DUB Show Tour in Los Angeles this Sunday, March 22nd. The DUB Show Tour, proudly sponsored in part by Rockstar Games, is a premier nationwide car show and concert tour spanning 12 US cities.

---The line-up of West Coast hip-hop all-stars playing Midnight Club: Los Angeles on Xbox LIVE at the event is headlined by Cali's most influential DJ, DJ FELLI FEL - known for his long-running primetime radio show on Los Angeles' Power 106 as well as for his own self-produced smash hits like 2008's "Get Buck in Here" featuring Akon, Ludacris, Lil Jon and Diddy (as heard in the Midnight Club Los Angeles soundtrack).

Also slated to play:

DJ POOH - A true pioneer of West Coast hip-hop, DJ Pooh got his start deejaying and producing for the legendary King Tee and went on to become one of the most prolific producers in the game, responsible for producing the rap classic "It Was a Good Day" by Ice Cube and other revered material by LL Cool J, Yo-Yo, 2Pac and many more. Pooh is also an accomplished filmmaker and writer, having written and starred in the classic 1995 West Coast comedy "Friday" and co-written Rockstar's own Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas in 2004.

GLASSES MALONE - One of LA's hottest new rappers, Glasses Malone is known throughout Los Angeles as much for his vocals as for his real deal street racing credentials. The rapping embodiment of Midnight Club: Los Angeles appears on the Statik-Selektah-produced theme song for South Central Premium Upgrade, "Rollin' Down the Freeway", along with Kali & Termanology - where he offers a glimpse of what the true life LA street racing scene is all about. Glasses' debut album, featuring Lil' Wayne and many others, is coming this year via a joint-label deal with Baby's Birdman Records and Mack 10's Hoo Bangin' Records.

BISHOP LAMONT - Dr. Dre's protégé and Aftermath/Interscope label signee, Bishop Lamont, is one of the most anticipated new rappers in hip-hop. The Los Angeles' native's debut album, The Reformation, is coming this year with production from Dre, The RZA, DJ Premier and others. His hard-hitting track "City Lights", produced by DJ Khalil, appears on the Midnight Club: Los Angeles soundtrack.

YOUNG MAYLAY - A protégé of DJ Pooh and WC, Young Maylay burst into notoriety in 2004 with his star-making turn voicing the lead character of Carl "CJ" Johnson in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Since then, Maylay has been making a name for himself in the West Coast rap scene with acclaimed underground hip-hop releases including 2008's stellar independent album, The Real Coast Guard, produced by Crazy Toones. Maylay's "You Ain't Uh" off that album also appears on the Midnight Club: Los Angeles soundtrack.

So log onto Xbox LIVE this Sunday from 1-5 PM PST (4-8 PM EST), add the below gamertags to your friends list and start practicing your driving skills now.

RockstarDub01

RockstarDub03

RockstarDub04

RockstarDub05

Visit Xbox.com's Game with Fame page for further info.

Visit Xbox.com's Game with Fame page for further info.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB: LOS ANGELES SOUTH CENTRAL SOUNDTRACK REVEALED. 'DOUBLE–A–SIDED' SOUNDTRACK EP NOW AVAILABLE AT iTUNES™
newsItem.body:
The South Central Premium Upgrade comes equipped with a new collection of 9 new songs handpicked for the South Central experience - including two original tracks created exclusively for the game, inspired directly by Midnight Club Los Angeles.

---KiD CuDi "Switchin Lanes"
Hot off his worldwide smash single "Day N' Nite" (first heard in last year's original Midnight Club Los Angeles release), Kanye West protégé and GOOD Music label signee, KiD CuDi teams up with producer Emile to bring this hypnotic custom-made track to Midnight Club: Los Angeles South Central.  "Switchin Lanes" tells about a night of cruising, scene-stealing and recklessly tearing up the asphalt in Los Angeles. Download the full original track as part of the 'double-A-sided' Midnight Club: Los Angeles - South Central Soundtrack EP at iTunes.

Statik Selektah feat Glasses Malone, Kali & Termanology - "Rollin Down the Freeway"
As heard in the official Midnight Club Los Angeles South Central trailer, "Rollin Down the Freeway" is as authentic a theme song of Los Angeles street racing as you can get.  The track is anchored with a verse by one of LA's hottest new rappers, Glasses Malone - who is known throughout Los Angeles as much for his vocals as for his real deal street racing credentials.  The rapping embodiment of Midnight Club Los Angeles uses his verse in this Statik Selektah-produced custom track to offer a glimpse of what the true life LA street racing scene is all about.  Riding shotgun and leading off on the track is Statik Selektah's own new west coast artist, Kali ("Midnight Club, I'm a savage on the streets") -- and the hook is performed by underground favorite, Termanology, who can also be heard in the Lost and Damned soundtrack with his own original solo song "Here in Liberty City".  Get the full original track as part of the 'double-A-sided' Midnight Club: Los Angeles - South Central Soundtrack EP at iTunes.

Visit the Soundtrack area of the Midnight Club: Los Angeles South Central official site to hear the exclusive original songs in embeddable audio player format and to see the complete in-game tracklist of new music.

The eligible player with the best recorded time on PLAYSTATION®3 and the eligible player with the best recorded time on Xbox 360® will each win a Midnight Club Los Angeles prize pack and a $300 shopping spree at Rockstar Warehouse. We're not done! All Social Club members who log in and participate at any time during the weekend will be eligible to win one of the 24 Rockstar prize packs we'll be giving away each day - that breaks down to one for each hour of the entire weekend. For eligibility, rules, and other details for all of the above Social Club Weekend events - go to www.rockstargames.com/socialclub/weekend.

newsItem.headline: SOUTH CENTRAL UPGRADE AND CONTENT PACK FOR MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES ANNOUNCED
newsItem.body:
Today we are proud to announce the South Central Upgrade and Content Pack for Midnight Club Los Angeles.---This massive downloadable upgrade and content pack will be available early next year for the Xbox 360® video game and entertainment system from Microsoft and PLAYSTATION®3 computer entertainment system.

The "South Central Upgrade Map" provides players with a whole new area of the city, about one-third the size of the original map, and will be available for free. This area features L.A. landmarks such as Exposition Park, the USC campus, Shrine Auditorium, Crenshaw Plaza, and the L.A. Memorial Coliseum and stretches south to the 105 Freeway. In addition to the free new city area, players will be able to purchase the "South Central Content Pack" which includes new character competitions, races, cars and music available in a single complete package. The new vehicles include a variety of cars and a motorcycle. Also making an appearance for the first time in Midnight Club Los Angeles will be SUVs, a longtime favorite of the series' fans.

"This downloadable content hones in on a very iconic area of Los Angeles," said Jay Panek, Midnight Club Producer at Rockstar San Diego. "'This South Central download features staples of the area, from the landmarks to the types of cars, and we think it really helps enhance the overall L.A. feel we set out to recreate."

For more details on the South Central Upgrade and Content Pack, stay tuned to the official Midnight Club site in the coming weeks.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES REVIEWS ROUNDUP
newsItem.body:
Continued high praise for the next generation debut of the genre-defining Midnight Club series:

"Midnight Club Los Angeles is an amazing racing game... The action is top shelf. A ton of real-world cars are available that look, handle and get damaged just like their non-virtual counterparts. All kinds of after-market add-ons let you fully pimp your ride. And the lack of game load time means dropping into the open world of greater L.A. and choosing a racing challenge is seamless and fast." – The Los Angeles Times

---"Car fetishists are sure to drool, but Midnight Club Los Angeles also has the potential to make neurotic auto geeks out of a broad swath of gamers who can't even drive stick shift." – Variety

"Rockstar created the open-world street racing genre, and with Midnight Club Los Angeles, they've perfected it." - GameSpy

"an accurate representation of what breakneck,-high-speed street racing is really all about." – TeamXbox

"Midnight Club: Los Angeles is gorgeous. It may in fact be the best-looking game of the year." - UGO

newsItem.headline: GAME INFORMER REVIEW
newsItem.body:
The latest issue of Game Informer features a full page review of Midnight Club Los Angeles.---Here a small preview of what they had to say:

"Midnight Club is back for next-gen consoles, and fans will be shocked at just how good their old favorite looks... The cityscape is amazing. The level of detail and sheer amount of roadway to tear up seems limitless... the insane speeds and canny enemy AI will put your skills to the test... the control mechanics are dead-on, offering a superb mix of arcade accessibility and fine control... all the customization features (visual and performance based) of the last game and more... Midnight Club: Los Angeles is just what the doctor ordered: a fun, fast racing experience with enough content to keep you playing for months."

newsItem.headline: MUSIC SECTION LAUNCH - OFFICIAL SOUNDTRACK REVEALED
newsItem.body:
Today's update features the first details about the full in-game soundtrack - a whopping collection of amped-up music perfect to race and ride to - from both cutting-edge underground artists and established legends.---

For Midnight Club Los Angeles, extra attention has been paid to the contemporary sonic landscape of California - artists from up and down the West Coast, and songs that have been getting lots of radio and club burn in L.A. specifically. The end result is a massive, yet carefully cultivated soundtrack that should appeal universally to rock, hip-hop, electronic and eclectic music lovers worldwide - and deliver a fitting, exhilarating score to complement all that intense in-game street racing action.

Check out the MUSIC section of the official website right now to check out a full track list of all 97 songs, broken down by genre - as well as full credits with links relevant to each song.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB L.A. REMIX SECTION OPENED
newsItem.body:
The successor to the best-selling racing game of all time on the PSP® (PlayStation®Portable) system is also coming this Tuesday.---Optimized for portable gameplay with quicker races and reduced load times, Midnight Club L.A. Remix brings not only Los Angeles but also an exclusive second city - Tokyo - with all the signature open city high-octane street racing fans of Midnight Club know to expect.

Check out the Official Remix Section for more info including all the exclusive SPECIAL FEATURES and a selection of in-game SCREENSHOTS.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL SITE UPDATE – BEVERLY HILLS SECTION OPENED, OFFICIAL WIDGET & SCREENSAVER UPDATED AND MORE
newsItem.body:
The final stop in our tour around L.A. before the release of Midnight Club Los Angeles - arrives with a preview of the fully loaded luxury sedans and exotic sports cars of Beverly Hills.---Today's update includes the revelation of five more cars from the in-game collection - a high-end range of luxury vehicles from Mercedes-Benz, Lamborghini, Audi and more.

Don't forget to check out the latest updates to the Official Widget and Official Screensaver -- respectively updated with new media and vistas of the five new cars from the Beverly Hills update.

The highly-anticipated arrival of the foremost street racing franchise on Xbox 360® and PLAYSTATION®3 is now less than one week away. CLICK HERE for a selection of online retailers to sort out that last minute pre-order of Midnight Club Los Angeles; reserve your copy and ensure you're not left in the dust on October 21st.

newsItem.headline: LIVE LAUNCH EVENT FEATURING EAGLES OF DEATH METAL AT THE VIRGIN MEGASTORE IN LOS ANGELES
newsItem.body: We will be kicking off the release of Midnight Club Los Angeles quite appropriately with a special live in-store performance by soundtrack artists Eagles of Death Metal at the Hollywood & Highland Virgin Megastore location.---Early attendees can play Midnight Club Los Angeles prior to release, followed by a live set and autograph session with the band. Look for Eagles of Death Metal's new album Heart On coming on October 28th and click here to download a special exclusive remix commissioned by Rockstar of their soundtrack-featured song "Wannabe in L.A.".

newsItem.headline: ROCKSTAR AND JORDAN BRAND PRESENT: THE LIMITED-EDITION MIDNIGHT CLUB AIR JORDAN II
newsItem.body:
Rockstar is proud to announce this special collaboration with Jordan Brand which has yielded the limited-edition Midnight Club Air Jordan II.---A true collectors' item for the consummate Midnight Club and Air Jordan fan. Only forty pairs have been manufactured of this custom-designed sneaker, styled in red and black with the official Midnight Club "Kanji" symbol emblazoned in red on the tongue.

These sneakers come in a specially-made etched acrylic collectors' box with a copy of Midnight Club Los Angeles itself, and altogether is valued at $380. Stay tuned for your chance to win a pair of these coveted kicks via special contests and sweepstakes through the Rockstar Social Club, and through our partners at Foot Action and DUB Magazine.

newsItem.headline: MULTIPLAYER MODES UNVEILED AND PREVIEWED
newsItem.body:
Today's official site update features the unveiling of Midnight Club Los Angeles' Multiplayer modes. Click here for the newly opened Multiplayer section of the official site, with full info on all the modes, plus a nifty new gallery of Multiplayer action screens.---

For more details on the Midnight Club Los Angeles multiplayer experience, including details on multiplayer power-ups and hands-on impressions, check out these features on 1up, IGN and TeamXbox.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL SITE UPDATE – HOLLYWOOD HILLS SECTION OPENED WITH NEW CARS AND VIDEO CLIPS REVEALED
newsItem.body:
The HOLLYWOOD HILLS section of the Official Website is now open, showcasing 5 more vehicles from the in-game collection of aspirational licensed cars and bikes – including videos of the cult-classic '99 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec and the Ducati 999R, as well as 3D screenshots of those models plus the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR, the '69 Mustang Boss 302 and the '71 Lamborghini Miura.---All perfect for those steep climbs and hairpin turns around the hills of Mulholland Drive and Laurel Canyon.

The Official Widget and the Official Screensaver have also been updated with all five of today's cars. The widget includes new videos and screenshots; while the screensaver features 5 new vistas of the Evo, Skyline, Ducati 999R, '69 Mustang and '71 Miura laying in wait in iconic spots around the Hollywood Hills. Of course, if you already have either of these items pre-installed on your webpage or computer respectively - these updates should automatically dynamically appear now. If you do not already have either of these items, grab them from the DOWNLOADS page.

Less than one month remains now until the October 21st release of this year's most anticipated street racing game, Midnight Club Los Angeles. Visit the BUY NOW section for online ordering options.

newsItem.headline: WIN THE SALEEN S302 EXTREME IN THE MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES & PIZZA HUT $100,000 CAR GIVEAWAY
newsItem.body:
Rockstar and Pizza Hut have teamed up to give away a one-of-a-kind Saleen S302 Extreme dream car, as seen on the cover of Midnight Club Los Angeles.---Plus other sweepstakes prizes like TIS rims, T-Mobile Sidekicks, customized Xbox 360's, and jackets from Five Four. Click here for your chance to win 550 horses of pure American racing muscle.

www.pizzahut.com

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL SOUNDTRACK SAMPLER GIVEAWAYS AT FOOT ACTION
newsItem.body: Stop by any Foot Action store nationwide and receive an exclusive Midnight Club Los Angeles promo disc with any purchase - featuring three mp3s from the in-game soundtrack - including tracks by Kidz in the Hall, Get Cool and J Mill, as well as other exclusive Midnight Club Los Angeles downloads.

newsItem.headline: NEW SPECIAL ABILITIES VIDEO CLIP
newsItem.body: New to the official site today, a video showcasing one of the Midnight Club series' returning fan-favorite gameplay features -- the Special Abilities.---Four special arcade-style powers that you earn as you progress through Career Mode - including EMP (Electro Magnetic Pulse) to temporarily disable your competitors' engines, Roar to part the sea of traffic ahead, Agro to plow through cars in front of you, and Zone to send real-time into slow motion, facilitating maximum time to control around impossible turns and maneuvers. Head over to the VIDEOS page to see the Special Abilities in action.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL SITE UPDATE – DOWNTOWN L.A., 5 NEW CARS REVEALED, VIDEO CLIPS, 3D SCREENS AND MORE
newsItem.body:
Today - the launch of the Downtown Los Angeles page features a healthy dose of new cars revealed from the in-game Midnight Club Los Angeles collection - heavy on all-American muscle cars like the Dodge Charger SRT-8 and the '69 Camaro RS SS - plus the hot, speedy tuner, the Mazda RX-8 Shinka.---Well-suited for gunning and dodging down the interweaving freeways that surround downtown Los Angeles.

Check out the exclusive Downtown L.A. Tour Video, as well as videos of the Chevrolet Camaro Concept DUB Edition, Mazda RX-8 Shinka, and 1979 Pontiac Firebird in action tearing through Los Angeles. Plus interactive 3D screenshots for all of today's new cars and more.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL WIDGET & SCREENSAVER UPDATE
newsItem.body: Today's update includes new content that's been added to the Official Widget and Screensaver.---The Official Widget includes media from today's new car reveals - with information, video and screenshot content added. The Screensaver now features five new vistas dynamically added, showing the latest collection of vehicles laying in wait at iconic places around Downtown Los Angeles.

newsItem.headline: NEW SPECIAL VIDEO CLIP: CUSTOMIZATION
newsItem.body: The VIDEOS section of the official site has been updated with a special clip focusing on vehicle customization in Midnight Club Los Angeles. The video, featuring the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR, showcases extensive modifications including the debut of fully customized interiors, along with a look at some of the infinite paint options, concept body parts and custom vinyls.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL SITE UPDATE – NEW CARS REVEALED, SANTA MONICA SECTION OPENED, AND MORE
newsItem.body:
Today, five more cars from the Midnight Club Los Angeles in-game collection are revealed.---In honor of the opening of the SANTA MONICA section of the official website, we are featuring a special line-up of convertibles, tuners and a sport bike - perfect for ripping up the coastline.

Check out the Santa Monica section or the VIDEOS page for clips featuring the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-14, Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster and the Volkswagen R32.

Visit the CARS section for new interactive 3d screenshots of the vehicles mentioned above as well as the Pontiac Solstice and 1999 Mitsubishi Eclipse GSX - and head over to the BUY NOW section to reserve your copy of Midnight Club Los Angeles in advance of the October 21st release date.

To stay on top of all the latest updates, including the upcoming launch of the DOWNTOWN section and information about Multiplayer modes and details on Midnight Club LA Remix - subscribe to the Rockstar Games email list or RSS feed.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL WIDGET & DOWNLOADS UPDATED
newsItem.body:
The Official Midnight Club Los Angeles Widget has been updated with an entirely new CARS section, where all the vehicles featured on the official site will appear dynamically as they're revealed, including today's latest set.---

New special functionality has been also added to the GRAB IT tab – now allowing you to set specifically which page of the Widget you'd like to appear by default on your website, blog or social networking profile. If you've already embedded this widget on your page, these updates should be already automatically appearing there. No need to re-embed from the source unless you'd like to designate a section to appear by default.

Also check out the DOWNLOADS section of the official site for new buddy icons, avatars and wallpapers featuring the Midnight Club Los Angeles official box art. The official screensaver has been dynamically updated as well with five new vistas of today's newly revealed cars, laying in wait for action in and around Santa Monica.

www.rockstargames.com/midnightclubLA/downloads

newsItem.headline: FULL AFTERMARKET PARTS LIST REVEALED
newsItem.body: Today's official site update includes the unveiling of the complete aftermarket parts list for Midnight Club Los Angeles.---Check out the CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS section for a complete breakdown of customization accessories for interiors, exteriors and performance & handling.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES US MULTIPLAYER DEBUT AT PAX
newsItem.body:
At the 5th annual Penny Arcade Expo (PAX) this weekend, gamers attending the show will have a first chance to go hands-on with Midnight Club Los Angeles multiplayer.---

The Penny Arcade Expo takes place at the Washington State Convention and Trade Center in Seattle, Washington from August 29th – 31st. For more details, visit www.pennyarcadeexpo.com.

newsItem.headline: OFFICIAL TRAILER #3 DEBUT
newsItem.body:
Check out the VIDEOS section for the release of the third official trailer for Midnight Club Los Angeles, featuring the award-winning, mid-engine masterpiece... the Audi R8 tearing through the City of Angels in style.---

Next week, be on the lookout for the launch of the Santa Monica section of the official site, featuring new and exclusive videos, screenshots and more. Remember to sign up to the Rockstar Games email list or RSS feed for instant notification on all updates.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES OFFICIAL SITE LAUNCH
newsItem.body:
Welcome back to the Midnight Club. Today marks the debut of the official website for Midnight Club Los Angeles, featuring the first stop on our guided tour of the City of Angels – HOLLYWOOD.---See what it's like to cruise the Sunset Strip in style, with some of the hottest exotics and baddest muscle cars in the world - namely, the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder, Dodge Challenger Concept DUB Edition, Corvette Z06, Ford GT and Saleen S302 Extreme. Just a few of the vehicles in the game that we will be revealing over the coming months. The Hollywood section features intense videos of in-game racing, glorious screenshots, and details on each car. Look for the launches of the Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Hollywood Hills and Downtown LA sections coming soon - with a range of specially-selected featured vehicles to suit each distinctive area of town.

Check out the CARS section for more on our launch set of featured Midnight Club Los Angeles vehicles, including a taste of available customization options, as well as 3D interactive screenshots with zoom and 360-spin modes to see the unmatched detail and insane arcade racing that the Midnight Club franchise has become synonymous with.

In the weeks ahead leading up to game release, we will be updating the site with first details on Multiplayer modes, Music from the soundtrack, the LA Remix special version for PSP® (PlayStation®Portable) system, and of course a wealth more vehicle revelations, info, and hot in-game racing media.

Midnight Club Los Angeles will be available October 21st in North America and October 10th in Europe. Visit the BUY NOW section for a list of online retail options and subscribe to the Rockstar Games email list or RSS feed for first word on all official site updates.

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES OFFICIAL WIDGET & DOWNLOADS
newsItem.body:
Visit the DOWNLOADS section of the Official Midnight Club Los Angeles Website to grab the Official Midnight Club Los Angeles Widget -- with dynamically updated Videos, Screenshots, News and info about the game that will be continuously updated leading up to Midnight Club Los Angeles' launch on October 21st 2008.---Click the GRAB IT button and paste embed code directly onto your website, blog or social networking profile. The DOWNLOADS section also has on offer:
  • A wide selection of official Midnight Club Los Angeles desktop wallpapers available for a wide variety of formats -- from handheld devices like Blackberry and PSP, to widescreen and double-monitor desktop spreads -- and all the standard sizes in between.
  • Official buddy icons & avatars - to let everyone know Midnight Club Los Angeles is among your most wanted.
  • And last but not least, the Midnight Club Los Angeles screensaver - a special full-screen stylized presentation of in-game views of vehicles in signature Los Angeles locations, ready for action. If you have a broadband connection, this screensaver will dynamically update in the future with more cars and locations.

newsItem.headline: GAMESRADAR'S "10 REASONS MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES WILL ROCK YOUR PANTS"
newsItem.body:
GamesRadar has posted their top 10 reasons why the upcoming release of Midnight Club Los Angeles has them excited.---Here's a brief snippet from one of their biggest reasons, the unparalleled recreation of Los Angeles:

"Sure, it's gorgeous, with all the next-gen glitz we've come to deserve, but the devil is in the details. As much as we generally bitch about in-game ads, the actual billboards, vendors and landmarks provide authenticity, creating a living, breathing city..." To see GamesRadar's entire list, click here to read the article.

newsItem.headline: GAME INFORMER HANDS–ON PREVIEW
newsItem.body: Pick up the August issue of Game Informer, available on newsstands now, for a special early hands-on preview of Midnight Club Los Angeles.---"With a great feature set, insanely fast racing action, and the challenging yet approachable control that has been the hallmark of the series, Midnight Club: Los Angeles is shaping up to be not only the strongest entry in the series thus far, but one of 2008's best racing experiences."

newsItem.headline: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES AT THE DUB SHOW TOUR 2008
newsItem.body:
We are proud to be featuring Midnight Club Los Angeles all summer long at the Dub Show Tour 2008 - the world's largest custom auto show and concert tour, presented by renowned automotive customization enthusiasts, DUB Magazine.---Midnight Club Los Angeles is the only videogame to feature cars customized by DUB. The DUB Show Tour is hitting stops across America this summer with the following upcoming dates:
  • Aug 23rd: Houston, TX (Reliant Center)
  • Aug 31st: San Jose, CA (San Jose Convention Center)
  • Sept 28th: San Diego, CA (San Diego Convention Center)
Visit the Rockstar Games: Midnight Club Los Angeles booth area at any of these shows to play the game in advance of its October 21st release date - play an exclusive demo featuring the Midnight Club Los Angeles Saleen S302E and get the chance to win limited-edition gear. For tickets and further info visit www.dubshowtour.com.
